title: Machine learning guides the solid-solution ratio of a stannite-type photocatalyst
summary: The prediction mapped an optimum near (x, y) = (0.6, 0.3); experiments found activity peaking near (0.8, 0.6), and the solid solution had longer-wavelength response and higher H2 evolution than Ag2ZnMS4. The prediction missed the exact optimum.
ai_technology: Machine learning prediction mapping using chemically similar out-of-domain data
organization: Nara Institute of Science and Technology, Japan

evidence.unknown: Abstract only; prediction missed exact optimum; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: ML prediction mapping of solid-solution composition guided photocatalyst synthesis

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
